prompts.title: Pop Art Portrait of a Man with Headphones
prompts.prompt:
Create a highly detailed comic-book / graphic-novel style digital illustration of a confident handsome man wearing large black over-ear headphones. He has neatly styled hair, blue eyes, strong eyebrows, defined facial features, and a calm, serious expression while looking directly at the camera.
He is dressed in a black leather jacket with realistic glossy folds and texture, layered over a plain black crew-neck T-shirt, with a thick silver Cuban-link chain necklace around his neck. Frame him as a centered chest-up portrait, with the head and shoulders occupying most of the composition.
Use a bold bright yellow background with an energetic street-art / comic aesthetic. Add scattered black ink splashes, paint droplets, halftone dots, geometric abstract shapes, diagonal graphic accents, and subtle distressed texture around the subject. Use thin black comic outlines, sharp cel-shading, cross-hatching, stippling, and carefully detailed rendered skin and hair details.
Lighting should be dramatic but clean, with strong highlights on the face, hair, headphones, jacket, and necklace. Maintain a sophisticated modern graphic novel / premium editorial illustration appearance, combining realistic facial proportions with stylized comic rendering.
Composition: symmetrical, straight-on camera angle, centered face, tight chest-up framing, strong visual hierarchy, crisp edges, high contrast.
Color palette: vibrant yellow background, black and charcoal clothing, warm peach skin tones, cool blue eyes, metallic silver necklace.
Style: ultra-detailed comic book illustration, premium digital art, dynamic ink work, bold outlines, realistic anatomy, cel shading, halftone texture, cinematic lighting, sharp details, 8K quality.
Aspect ratio 4:5.

Natural directional daylight creates deep cinematic shadows, subtle highlights, rich monochrome contrast, and realistic skin and fabric textures. Every facial feature is rendered with microscopic precision, preserving realistic anatomy and subtle facial contours.

The abstract elements softly frame the portrait without overpowering the subject, creating a refined contemporary fine-art composition.

prompts.title: A Stoic Profile
prompts.prompt:
Create an 8k ultra-high-resolution mixed-media portrait illustration that blends photorealistic character rendering with expressive watercolor and architectural sketch techniques.
Face Matching & Identity Accuracy:
Match the face and identity with high accuracy from the provided reference image.
Subject & Expression:
Subject is very confident. His facial features are sharp and realistic with detailed skin texture and defined cheekbones. His expression is serious, focused, and contemplative, with a subtle furrow in his brow. His gaze looks upward and off-camera, suggesting determination and forward vision.
Pose:
Chest-up portrait. The torso is angled slightly toward the viewer’s left while the head turns upward toward the right side of the frame. This twist in the shoulders and neck creates a dynamic, heroic stance.
Outfit:
A dark charcoal-black short-sleeve polo shirt with a ribbed collar and a two-button placket. The shirt is rendered with painterly shading and sketch-style cross-hatching that gradually dissolves into watercolor textures toward the lower part of the portrait.
Composition & Camera Angle:
Medium close-up (chest-up). Slight low-angle “hero shot” perspective that emphasizes the jawline and gives the subject a powerful presence. The subject is placed slightly off-center, leaving negative space around the head and shoulders.
Lighting:
Dramatic directional lighting from the upper left side. The light highlights the forehead, nose bridge, and cheekbones while casting deeper shadow along the opposite side of the face and neck, creating strong contrast and depth.
Background & Artistic Style:
Clean white background with no physical environment. Behind the subject are expressive orange watercolor splashes, ink drips, and paint blooms forming an energetic halo. Thin architectural pencil construction lines and sketch marks intersect across the composition, adding structure and motion.
Artistic Medium & Texture:
A hybrid style combining photorealistic digital painting, loose watercolor washes, ink splatter effects, and raw sketch linework. The face remains highly detailed and realistic while the shoulders and lower areas transition into unfinished painterly strokes and abstract watercolor textures.
Color Palette:
Natural warm skin tones contrasted with a dark black shirt and vibrant watercolor hues of burnt orange, amber, and sienna against a bright white canvas.
Technical Details:
Ultra-detailed digital illustration, 8K resolution, sharp facial focus, painterly brush textures, watercolor bloom effects, ink splashes, architectural sketch lines, soft fade-out edges.
Aspect ratio 4:5

prompts.title: Painted Blue
prompts.prompt:
An ultra-detailed watercolor portrait of myself.

CRITICAL:

Use the reference image only for face and identity.
Respect the facial bone structure and proportions 100%.
Do not modify any facial features.

COMPOSITION:
Medium-short 3/4 angle portrait. Subject occupies approximately 67–75% of the frame. Body is angled slightly to the left side, with shoulders turned naturally away from the camera, while the head is gently rotated back toward the camera. Balanced headroom and clean framing with upper torso visible. Direct eye contact.

FACE:
Warm skin tone with realistic texture, expressive eyes acting as the focal point, and a subtle, natural soft smile (not wide, not exaggerated) with slight asymmetry.

HAIR:
Well-groomed, color matching the attached photo, organic volume, with soft watercolor edges.

STYLE:
Professional watercolor on cold-press paper, utilizing granulating pigments, transparent layering, and a blend of soft and defined edges. The final image should not have a filter effect.

LIGHTING:
Soft natural side lighting with warm tones, clean transitions, and no opaque whites.

CLOTHING:
A red t-shirt layered under a worn denim jacket, featuring realistic texture and moderate contrast that does not compete with the face.

BACKGROUND:
A neutral watercolor wash with organic blooms and splatters, integrated softly with the silhouette.

EDGE TREATMENT (CRITICAL):
The lower part of the subject (torso area) must softly dissolve and blend into the background using watercolor bleed, diffusion, and irregular fading edges — no hard cut, no sharp boundary.

MOOD:
Elegant, natural, intimate, showing an effortless confident presence.

QUALITY:
High definition, fine detail, showcasing realistic pigment behavior.

FORMAT:
Vertical orientation (3:4).
